lines.t: I hear two voices in my head One drags me down, one lifts me up instead
Flesh says I'm too broken to be loved again Want to sit every scar like a smoking gun in my hand
Says I'm just my face, I'm the chaos and the sin
That I'll hurt the ones I love if they let me back in
Spirit whisper softly, you're more than what you've done
You're the one I died for, yeah we doubted your sign
Get up from the ashes, I'm not finished with your name
I create you for your healing, not to drown you in your sin
So which voice in my heart will let define me now?
The one that changed my heart or the one that breaks me up?
Fast as you're hoping, you'll never get free
Spirit says, child, come and walk with me
Fast as you're crazy, you're only a pain
Spirit says, beloved, I'm making you new again
Just keep shouting that you're too far gone
Still keep singing as you belong
Caught in tension, but I'm loving to hear it
Silence the lies and follow the spirit, yeah
That's it, run back and wish for me in the night
Dumb it with the drama, with the body, with the fire
Stress on me, you're lonely like a trauma, be your home
You're the only real healer when you're scared of being alone
Stealer draws a line, I'll not hit it, crush the stone
I'm tearing down the addles just to make a heart hole
I just close the way you're beating so I finally can restore
I'm not coming to destroy you, I'm destroying what's a war
Every time I'm standing at that open door
I can feel the battle, I've been losing before
But this time I'm breathing, this time I'll choose
I never was a peasant over every accused and true
Flesh as your heart, you'll never get free
Spirits that shout, oh come and walk with me
Flesh says you're crazy, you're only a pain
Speed turns to love, I'm thinking you'll never get
Flesh keeps shouting, you're too far gone
Spirit keeps shaking, you still belong
Caught in the tension, but I'm learning to hear it
Silence the light to follow the spirit
I'm unlearning to listen
To the holy conviction
That the old man died, so new man rises in sight
Let's see Jesus dance, so he will break your heart
If you let him in your sacred, he will tear your world apart
Spray with cells, I'm jealous for the real you want to meet
I'm cutting off the chains so you can finally breathe
Flat spares, you're just madness, you're the labor, you're the stain
The living, dying circles, you're just wrecking all the plans
Spirit actions, high cousin, in your range, you need me tears
If you're walking to the light, I don't want these two-stick gears
So I'm standing in the middle with my hands up high
Saying, Lord, I need your truth
More than I need the eyes
Let's raise your hope, don't ever be free
Spin this and shout, come and walk with me
Let's raise you crazy, go on in your pain
Spirit says to love you, don't make it, you know it, yeah
Let's get shot, it's too far, go too hard
Let's make it, see it, still belong
Caught in tension, but I don't need to fear
Silence the lies, follow the spirit
I've been calling judgment, Lord I've been calling bondage, home
I've been calling all these voices, me Whenever's fear, I've always known
But you're the fire in the frame, you're the cutting of the door
You're the stone that tears the walls down So my heart can't stand so sure
Strip away the counterfeit Let your word be like a song
If you have to break me open
Do it, Lord, to make me whole
Flesh says run, spirit says divest
Flesh says run, spirit says come and rest
Flesh says come, spirit says forget
Flesh creates the dead
But the spirit makes me alive
Flesh as you're homeless, you'll never get feet
Spirit says shout, put your eyes to me
Flesh as you're crazy, you're drowning in shame
Spirit says be loving, I'm calling you by name
Flesh can shake me, too far gone, too far gone
I keep seeing these stupid old videos
Keep winning in the conflict
I'd finally hear that
I lay down my glass
And follow the spirit
Yeah, I'm laying it down, laying it down
Every lie that used to drown me out
I hear your voice, quiet but clear
Don't be afraid, you're right here
Left face out in a darker night
Spilling leaves on in the morning light
